edges.reason: msg.sender flows into _mint via _msgSender() for ownership validation, burn and mint recipient.
block.timestamp is compared against mintStartTime and mintEndTime to gate minting.
mintTokens iterates tokenIds and invokes _mint for each entry.
External mint pass burn() is called before mintedSuit is updated.
_safeMint invokes onERC721Received on the recipient before mintedSuit is set.
_mint writes the mintedSuit mapping after performing external calls.
_mint calls _ownsParentToken to validate parent NFT ownership.
_mint reads _mintPassContractAddress to build the mint pass interface.
_ownsParentToken reads erc721ContractAddresses for the parent contract index.
_ownsParentToken reads erc1155ContractAddresses for the parent contract index.
_ownsParentToken calls external ownerOf on the configured ERC721 contract.
_ownsParentToken calls external balanceOf on the configured ERC1155 contract.
_ownsParentToken calls tokenStakes on the Wolf Game staking contract.
_ownsParentToken compares the parent contract against _wolfGameContractAddress.
_ownsParentToken uses _wolfGameStakingContractAddress to query stakes.
setMintTimes writes mintStartTime.
setMintTimes writes mintEndTime.
onlyRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE) validates _msgSender() before changing mint times.
onlyRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE) validates _msgSender() before authorizing an upgrade.
setErc721ContractAddresses writes erc721ContractAddresses entries.
setErc1155ContractAddress writes erc1155ContractAddresses.
setMintPassContractAddress writes _mintPassContractAddress.
setWolfGameContractAddress writes _wolfGameContractAddress.
setWolfGameStakingContractAddress writes _wolfGameStakingContractAddress.
tokenURI reads _baseMetadataURI through _baseURI().
setBaseURI writes _baseMetadataURI.
tokenIds parameter flows into the mintTokens loop.
_mintStartTime parameter is stored by setMintTimes.
_mintEndTime parameter is stored by setMintTimes.
tokenId parameter is decoded and used inside _mint.
wallet parameter is compared against the parent token owner.
parentTokenId parameter is used for ownerOf/balanceOf/tokenStakes queries.
parentContractIndex parameter indexes the contract address mappings.
indexes parameter drives the batch address assignment loop.
contractAddresses parameter supplies the addresses written.
baseURI parameter is assigned to _baseMetadataURI.
parentContractIndex local indexes mintedSuit and _ownsParentToken.
parentTokenId local indexes mintedSuit and _ownsParentToken.
suitId local indexes the mintedSuit mapping.
success local receives the return value of the external mint pass burn call.

normalization_plan.reason: tokenIds is a parameter consumed directly by the mintTokens loop and should be folded into that core function.
_mintStartTime is a parameter written to mintStartTime by setMintTimes and should merge into the setter.
_mintEndTime is a parameter written to mintEndTime by setMintTimes and should merge into the setter.
tokenId parameter is decoded and used exclusively inside _mint.
wallet parameter is only used for ownership verification inside _ownsParentToken.
parentTokenId parameter is only used inside _ownsParentToken external ownership queries.
parentContractIndex parameter is only used to index the mapping inside _ownsParentToken.
indexes parameter is only consumed by setErc721ContractAddresses.
contractAddresses parameter is only consumed by setErc721ContractAddresses.
baseURI parameter is only assigned to _baseMetadataURI inside setBaseURI.
parentContractIndex local is derived and used only within _mint.
parentTokenId local is derived and used only within _mint.
suitId local is derived and used only within _mint.
success local exists solely to capture the result of the external mint pass burn call.
